system.boundary: Build a Simulink model of a closed-loop adaptive digital-predistortion transmitter for a complex OFDM waveform driving a nonlinear RF power amplifier with memory.
engineering_objects: Build a Simulink model of a closed-loop adaptive digital-predistortion transmitter for a complex OFDM waveform driving a nonlinear RF power amplifier with memory.
The transmitted waveform must pass through an adaptive predistorter and the power-amplifier path, and the measured amplifier output must be fed back to update the predistorter online.
PaNonlinearityScale is between 0.9 and 1.1 and scales the nonlinear and memory terms of the identified power-amplifier behavior around its nominal operating point.
physical_paths: The transmitted waveform must pass through an adaptive predistorter and the power-amplifier path, and the measured amplifier output must be fed back to update the predistorter online.
The connected adaptive path should reduce aligned in-band waveform error and adjacent spectral regrowth while keeping its adaptive state bounded.

TxBaseband is the actual OFDM waveform entering the transmitter path; PredistortedDrive is the adaptive-predistorter output applied to the nonlinear power amplifier; PaOutput is the measured nonlinear-amplifier output; AdaptiveCoefficients is the online state used by that connected predistorter; and AdaptationError is the measured error that drives its online update.
Build a Simulink model of a closed-loop adaptive digital-predistortion transmitter for a complex OFDM waveform driving a nonlinear RF power amplifier with memory.
